sscresizer.content.heading1: What is an SSC Photo & Signature Resizer?
sscresizer.content.p1: An SSC Photo & Signature Resizer is a specialized tool engineered to help candidates applying for Staff Selection Commission (SSC) examinations—such as CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD Constable, and CPO—prepare their digital passport photograph and signature scans to match official online portal upload requirements. Online application forms automatically reject files that fall outside specific pixel dimensions, physical sizes (in cm or mm), or strict Kilobyte (KB) file size limits.
sscresizer.content.p2: While exact specifications can vary per official exam notification, common guidelines for SSC online submissions generally include:
sscresizer.content.reqPhoto: SSC Passport Photograph: Typically 3.5 cm (width) × 4.5 cm (height) or approximately 138 × 177 pixels (at 100 DPI) to 200 × 230 pixels, with a target file size between 20 KB and 50 KB in JPG/JPEG format.
sscresizer.content.reqSig: SSC Signature: Typically 4.0 cm to 6.0 cm (width) × 2.0 cm (height) or approximately 140 × 60 pixels, with a target file size between 10 KB and 20 KB in JPG/JPEG format.
sscresizer.content.heading3: How to Resize Passport Photo & Signature for SSC Portal
sscresizer.content.p3: Preparing your document files takes just a few simple steps:
sscresizer.content.step1: 1. Select either 'SSC Photo' or 'SSC Signature' mode.
sscresizer.content.step2: 2. Upload your scanned photo or signature by dragging it into the dropzone.
sscresizer.content.step3: 3. Click the relevant exam preset button or enter custom Width, Height, Unit (cm/mm/px), and target KB range.
sscresizer.content.step4: 4. Adjust cropping or aspect ratio to center your face or signature cleanly.
sscresizer.content.step5: 5. Review the Live Validation Checklist to ensure your output passes all dimension and file size checks.
sscresizer.content.step6: 6. Click 'Download' to save the verified JPG file to your device.
sscresizer.content.heading4: Understanding DPI and Physical Dimension Conversion
sscresizer.content.p4: DPI (Dots Per Inch) measures resolution when converting physical measurements (cm or mm) into digital pixel counts. For instance, a 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm photograph converted at 100 DPI results in 138 × 177 pixels, whereas at 200 DPI it yields 276 × 354 pixels. Our tool performs accurate physical-to-pixel mathematical conversions automatically.
sscresizer.content.heading5: Importance of JPG Format and KB Compression
sscresizer.content.p5: Most official recruitment portals, including SSC, strictly require JPG/JPEG format attachments. Our client-side optimization algorithm uses iterative binary search compression to fit your file cleanly within the target KB range (e.g. 20–50 KB for photos, 10–20 KB for signatures) without causing blurriness or smudging.
sscresizer.content.p6: Incorrectly formatted photos or signatures are among the top causes of application rejections. Avoid these critical mistakes:
sscresizer.content.mistake1: Dark or Shadowy Signature: Signing with a faint pen or taking a photo in low light. Always sign with black or dark blue ink on plain white paper.
sscresizer.content.mistake2: Inaudible/Blurry Photograph: Using low-resolution or cap/goggles photos. Ensure your face is clear, well-lit, and facing the camera with both ears visible.
sscresizer.content.mistake3: Incorrect File Extension: Uploading PNG or PDF files when the portal explicitly requests .jpg or .jpeg.
sscresizer.content.p7: Your sensitive identity documents and signature scans are never uploaded to any server or cloud database. ImgFeel processes all resizing, cropping, and compression entirely inside your browser's memory.
sscresizer.faq.q1: What is the official photo size for SSC exams?
sscresizer.faq.a1: Commonly, SSC requires a passport photo of 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm (20 KB to 50 KB in JPG format). Always check your specific exam notification for exact updates.
sscresizer.faq.q2: What is the required signature size for SSC forms?
sscresizer.faq.a2: SSC signature files usually require 4.0–6.0 cm × 2.0 cm (10 KB to 20 KB in JPG format).
sscresizer.faq.q3: Can I resize SSC photos on my mobile phone?
sscresizer.faq.a3: Yes, ImgFeel is fully mobile-responsive. You can take a photo of your signature or passport pic on your phone and resize it instantly.
sscresizer.faq.q4: Are my signature scans kept private?
sscresizer.faq.a4: Yes. All image processing occurs 100% locally in your web browser. No files are uploaded to any server.
